selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed redirect acceptance enabled. Subsequent evidence shows the persistent configuration and zero values for all, default, eth0, and loopback before and after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Both baseline and post-reboot evidence report AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID c207ab79-d913-4af0-b630-8f0104ee3ccd was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID 17d53d84-6ef7-47a0-99b2-51e3d8d344d8. The system and systemd-sysctl service are active, no units are failed, and all hardened values remain zero.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r
printf '%s\n' 'LIVE_VALUES'
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
printf '%s\n' 'PERSISTENCE_REFERENCES'
grep -RnsE '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.conf\.(all|default)\.(accept_redirects|accept_source_route)[[:space:]]*=' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d /usr/lib/sysctl.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' 'SERVICE_BASELINE'
systemctl is-system-running || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager || true
commands.stdout:

LIVE_VALUES
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 1
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
PERSISTENCE_REFERENCES
/usr/lib/sysctl.d/50-default.conf:30:net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0

running

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 022
printf '%s\n' '# Disable unsafe IPv4 routing options.' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
chown root:root /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf

set -eu
sysctl --system >/tmp/sysctl-system.out
printf '%s\n' 'CONFIG_FILE'
cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
printf '%s\n' 'RESOLVED_LIVE_VALUES'
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
printf '%s\n' 'CURRENT_INTERFACE_VALUES'
for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do printf '%s=' "$p"; cat "$p"; done
printf '%s\n' 'SYSTEM_STATE'
systemctl is-system-running

commands.command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '# Disable unsafe IPv4 routing options globally, on existing interfaces, and on future interfaces.' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_redirects = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0' 'net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_source_route = 0' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
chown root:root /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
systemctl restart systemd-sysctl
systemctl is-active systemd-sysctl

set -eu
printf '%s\n' 'CONFIG_FILE'
cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
printf '%s\n' 'ALL_IPV4_INTERFACE_VALUES'
failed=0
for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do v=$(cat "$p"); printf '%s=%s\n' "$p" "$v"; [ "$v" = 0 ] || failed=1; done
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'SYSTEM_STATE='; systemctl is-system-running
[ "$failed" -eq 0 ]
